notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.content:
The official demo is now out! You will be able to play up to the first boss with the Spectral faction. Try and beat the demo with multiple different builds.

Just an update on the development. Unfortunately development is currently on hiatus, due to my university studies. I originally planned to release the game in the summer of 2024, but this might mean that the game release will be pushed back later. However, I am fully committed to finishing the game, rest assured. Thank you for your patience!
